title: tilt
description: v0.1 device-model entity: van inclination (roll/pitch) from a GY-521 / MPU-6050 accelerometer, read directly by the renewvan/node-tilt node (sensing, not a feed remap). Published under renewvan/tilt/<id>/<property>. Every field is live (retained), republished when roll or pitch moves past a deadband and on a heartbeat; there are no identity/startup-only fields. Angles are in the van frame (x forward, y left, z up), smoothed, and corrected by the install-time level zero set via renewvan/tilt/<id>/level_zero/set. Whether the van counts as 'level' is a presentation tolerance applied by the consumer, not published here.

roll_deg.description: Roll about the van's forward axis, degrees. Positive = left side down. 0 = level (after level zero).

pitch_deg.description: Pitch about the van's lateral axis, degrees. Positive = nose up. 0 = level (after level zero).

status.description: IMU health. sensor_error after N consecutive failed I2C reads (or an all-zero accelerometer read); roll_deg/pitch_deg retain their last published values while in error.
